NONE: › to talk continuously and eagerly, especially about things that are not important
喋喋不休，嘮叨，閒聊（尤指説雞毛蒜皮的事）

example: I got so bored listening to him gabbing on about nothing.
他嘮嘮叨叨盡説些廢話，把我給煩透了。

U: › [ U ] a thick cloth that is especially used for making coats
（尤用來做外套的）華達呢，軋別丁
C: › [ C ] a long coat made from this cloth
用華達呢（或稱軋別丁）做的大衣

NONE: › to speak quickly and not clearly so that it is difficult to understand
急促不清地説；嘰哩咕嚕
› fast conversation or speech that is difficult to understand, often because many people are talking at the same time
（常指許多人同時急促地説話時）難以聽清的説話聲，嘈雜不清的話

example: She started gabbling away at me in Spanish and I didn't understand a word.
她開始嘰哩咕嚕地對我説西班牙語，我一個字都沒聽懂。
Gina, as usual, was gabbling away on the phone.
吉娜像往常一様在電話裡嘰嘰咕咕聊個沒完。

NONE: › the top end of the wall of a building, in the shape of a triangle, where it meets the sloping parts of a roof

example: With its narrow cobbled streets and gabled houses, Bruges must be one of the most beautiful cities in Europe.
布魯日擁有狹窄的鵝卵石街道和有著山牆的房屋，一定是歐洲最美的城市之一。
